steps.content: Is this the Chief of the MBCC? Mr. ${PlayerName}?
steps.female_content: Is this the Chief of the MBCC? Ms. ${PlayerName}?

steps.content: You receive an unidentified call. On the other end of the call is a polite yet haughty stranger.
Who is it?
I'm from the Eastside Public Security Bureau. I'm the primary officer in charge of criminal cases.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: I have something to discuss with you.
...What?

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: We have received your application for postponing the trial, but I think it's completely unnecessary.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: I request that you retract the application as soon as possible and send the Sinner to court on the original date.
The officer bluntly states his demand, but you refuse without a second thought.
Sorry, but I can't agree to that.
The MBCC has an obligation to thoroughly investigate all cases involving each Sinner. We can't release anyone arbitrarily before the investigation is complete.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: Are you questioning the results of our investigation?

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: With the complainant's authorization, we quickly identified the cause of death, the weapon, and the murderer. It's all clearly written in the file. Didn't you read it?

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: By doubting our professional capabilities, you're challenging the authority of the Public Security Bureau!
...I didn't mean that. Also, the complainant you mentioned... is it Mr. Braun's younger brother?

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: ...You even know about that? Ahem, I mean, that is correct.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: The younger Mr. Braun didn't want to be associated with a Sinner in any way. Losing a family member is already painful enough. It's even more traumatic when the killer is your own sister-in-law.

steps.speaker: Public Security Bureau Official
steps.content: So I hope you respect the privacy of the younger Mr. Braun, and hand over that Sinner to me immediately!
You keep feeling there's something fishy about this. If the Sinner is the murderer, public opinion would undoubtedly be on his side. Why would he go out of his way to hide his identity?
Moreover, from the officer's urgent attitude to the fact that he made a special call to pressure you, you feel that they're hiding something.

Nightingale, I'd like you to help me look into the officer in charge of criminal cases at the Public Security Bureau, as well as all those involved in the Garofano case... witnesses, examiners, investigators, etc.
I want to see if there's anything unusual about them, or if they have any connection with the younger Mr. Braun.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes, Chief. I'll report to you immediately if there are any updates.
Thank you, Nightingale.
When you arrive at Garofano's room, she's completely engrossed in her needlework.
However... The soft sewing fabric in her hands seems strangely familiar. You walk over, wanting to get a closer look.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Ah... it's you, Chief.
Perhaps because you've unknowingly gotten too close, she notices you.
Ahem, excuse me. I didn't disturb you, did I? Are you... mending Hella's hat?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Yes. I noticed a small hole in her hat, so I took it upon myself to mend it.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Is something the matter?
She asks softly, her hands still working. You sit down beside her.
Garofano, I have some more questions for you today.
Do you know Mr. Braun's younger brother... the younger Mr. Braun?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...The younger Mr. Braun?
She looks up at you, somewhat surprised.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Sorry, but they stopped contacting each other long before Mr. Braun passed away... So I don't really know much about him.
That's all right. Just tell me what you know.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...All right. Let me tell you what I know, then.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Actually... The relationship between the two brothers was quite tense.
Why?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Because the younger Mr. Braun... has some unhealthy hobbies.
She seems reluctant to say it.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: He's addicted to gambling, and often goes out to squander money. He made many bad friends.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Not only did Mr. Braun repay much of his debt, he also scolded him many times, but all to no avail.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Over time, I think Mr. Braun lost hope in his younger brother. One day, he told me he just wanted to split assets and cut ties.
...Did he want to split the property with the younger Mr. Braun?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Yes... Mr. Braun must have realized that limitless help can't make a gambler repent.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: However, before this could be implemented, he suddenly passed away.
Did the younger Braun brother know about Mr. Braun's plan to split their assets?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'm not sure...
Garofano shakes her head apologetically.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: By the way, I remembered another strange thing...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: The younger Mr. Braun had always despised me. I was an "outsider" to him. He always felt that I had taken his place in his brother's heart.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: But not long ago, he ordered a suit from my tailor shop.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: He came to my shop and tried on the suit several times. It seemed quite important to him. But when the suit was finally completed, he didn't come to pick it up...
Garofano feels puzzled, but you suddenly see the light. Through your conversation with her, you've found a breakthrough in the case.
Next, you just need to wait for Nightingale's information to complete the last piece of the puzzle.
I think, what he valued may not have been the suit.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: What do you mean...?
Thank you. The information you provided has been crucial. I'll go back and continue the investigation. See you next time...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Please wait a moment...!
To your surprise, Garofano gently tugs at you, her brow furrowed as she looks at your sleeve.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Didn't you notice that you've lost a button on your cuff?
I didn't notice at all...
You're a bit embarrassed. You try to pull your hand away to cover it, but she refuses to let go.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: As a tailor, I won't let anyone leave my shop looking unkempt.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Please let me mend it for you.
Faced with Garofano's gentle but insistent request, you can only stay still and let her hold onto your wrist.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Your pulse is beating very fast... Have you not been getting enough rest?
I suppose not. There's a lot to deal with recently...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I see... Work is important, but please don't put too much pressure on yourself.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: If you neglect your health because of your work, it would worry those who care about you.
As she expresses her concern, she skillfully takes out a similar button from her shawl and starts sewing.
You're so close to each other that you can smell the faint fragrance from her hair.

options: You pay a lot of attention to details.
You're great at taking care of others.

choices.text: You pay a lot of attention to details.
You're great at taking care of others.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Hehe... This is my shtick, after all.
As if having recalled something, her words are filled with doting nostalgia.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: My brother was a wild little rascal. Almost every time he came back home, I had to check if his clothes needed mending... It was really a headache.
steps.female_content: My sister loved beautiful clothes, but she grew up so fast that I had to keep making new ones for her...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: And then there's my younger sister, who absolutely adored beautiful clothes. But she grew up so fast that I had to constantly make new ones for her...
steps.female_content: And then there's my younger brother, who was a wild little rascal. Almost every time he came back home, I had to check if his clothes needed mending... It was really a headache.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I can still remember how they'd want me to baby them.
Garofano chuckles lightly. You can feel her breath on your wrist, causing a slight tingle of warmth. You can't help but twist your wrist.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Don't move... I won't prick you, but it's still better to be careful.
You stop moving, and soon, Garofano finishes up. She bites off the thread, puts the needle away, and smooths out your sleeve in satisfaction.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: There. Should be nice and sturdy now.
She gently caresses the button she had just sewn on.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: My mother once told me that a button symbolizes a bond. It not only maintains the emotions between people, but also conveys blessings to each other.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: So, I sew a button for every person I care about. Now, I'm also giving this blessing to you.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I hope this button can stay with you for a long time. When you're out and about, it can keep you safe and sound on my behalf.
Her tone is very serious, and you can't help but respond in kind.
...I'll cherish it. Thank you, Garofano.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Well, you can get back to your work now. Could you also deliver this to Hella for me, please?
As you clutch the mended hat that Garofano gave you, you run into Hella, who was wandering around. You pass on the hat to her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wow, Garofano is amazing! What a pro!
Hella is really impressed by what Garofano did to her hat, which looks as good as new. She eagerly puts it on.
Her skills really are outstanding.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, Ninety-Nine also wore out a lot of clothes. I also want...
Don't always be bothering and taking advantage of others.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I'm not! Garofano is so nice. She'll definitely want to help...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Forget it, pretend I said nothing. Adjutant Nightingale is looking for you. You should go to your office!
You rush back to the office. Sure enough, Nightingale is waiting there with a document.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, your hunch was correct.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The person in charge of this case has a close relationship with the younger Braun brother. They frequently go to underground entertainment venues together.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And the forensic examiner who performed the autopsy on Mr. Braun owes the younger Mr. Braun money.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That examiner purchased a batch of high-risk drugs, supposedly for research. The poison that killed Mr. Braun was also on the list.
...Didn't the court notice and investigate such obvious discrepancies?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Perhaps they just didn't want to investigate.
It's not even a complicated case, yet it was handled like this...
Should someone innocent be slandered just because they're a Sinner?
I won't allow that to happen.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: What do you plan to do next?
I will submit all this evidence to the court and request them to reopen the investigation.
I promised Garofano that if she was innocent, I would help her clear her name.
The evidence you submitted worked. Soon the court issued a new verdict, and Garofano was declared innocent.
You step into Garofano's room once again, intending to share this good news with her.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Chief, please sit down. You seem to be in a good mood. Is there something to be happy about?

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Let me guess... There's good news from the court, right?

options: You seem quite sure about that.

choices.text: You seem quite sure about that.

steps.content: I haven't said anything yet.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Your thoughts are written all over your face. Besides, I've always believed in you... The promise you gave has kept me strong all this time.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'm lucky to always meet saviors in desperate situations.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Thank you. I can finally prove my innocence now.
I regret to say that the younger Braun brother is the murderer in this case.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: After your last interrogation, I realized... how good Mr. Braun was to his only remaining relative when he was alive... What a pity...
Garofano sighs deeply, pausing the mending work in her hands.
If you want, on certain days, you can apply to go out to mourn Mr. Braun... and your family.
But you need to apply in advance. The procedures of the Bureau are a bit cumbersome.
You look into her eyes, trusting that she has understood what you are hinting at.
Even though the matter has been resolved, you still need to stay here. You are a Sinner. You can't go back to your previous life.
She stays silent for a moment, and just gently shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: It's okay, Chief. No one in that world remembers me anymore, so... let all of this be bygones.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: After coming here, I've prepared for the worst. The current situation is much better than I had imagined.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: You have done enough for me. No need to feel guilty about this.
Her tone is calm and heart-soothing.
It's as if no hardships can wear her down. Even though she's in a difficult situation, she can still resiliently comfort others.
...If you want, you can think of this place as your new home.
I, along with everyone in the Bureau... can also be your new family.
Garofano is surprised for a moment. She then smiles shyly, a faint blush spreading across her face.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: In truth, even without you saying this... I've already started viewing this place as my home.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Because, I really like it here... especially when I'm by your side.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'm so, so happy... that you're willing to be my family,

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I will definitely cherish you.
You feel relieved that she seems to have cheered up.
Do you need anything else? I promise to help within the best of my ability.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Hmm, there is indeed something I want to do...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I want to go back to my tailor shop to retrieve some tools and fabrics. Can you come with me?
No problem. I'll apply for a permit to leave right away. Once everything is arranged, I'll take you there.
